The '''''Tydia Rish''''' was a small personal transport ship used by [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. It was [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] capable and boasted a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] system capable of detecting life forms from orbit. The ''Rish'' was used by Fiolla on a mission to ferry a prisoner, [[Naven Crel]], to trial before she became embroiled in uncovering corruption within the [[Prex]]'s office.
